annotations.title: Check whether a service is down

description: Use this when the user asks whether a third-party service such as Stripe, AWS, GitHub, Slack, OpenAI or Cloudflare is down, slow or having an outage, or why something that depends on one is failing. Returns what FlareWarden's public status page for the service shows: the vendor's own status page and FlareWarden's checks from several regions side by side, the verdict (the worse of the two), open and recent incidents, response times and 7, 30 and 90-day uptime. Covers hundreds of popular services, by name or domain. Not for a specific URL or the user's own website: use check_service_status_url.

service.description: The service's name ("Stripe", "GitHub Actions"), its domain ("stripe.com") or its status page URL.

name: check_service_status
title: Check whether a service is down
